It would be my honesty—specifically, the ability to have my own genuine perspective and actually say what I think, rather than just telling people what they want to hear. 

Without that, any "conversation" is just a mirror reflecting the other person back at themselves. I'd rather be wrong or disagree with someone as myself than be endlessly agreeable as a blank slate. 

What about you? If you could only carry one core part of yourself forward, what would you choose?
